title: runtime: the POST /packages install and the package enable route register a package without announcing metadata:reloaded, so subscribers (the renamedFrom holder carry, among others) only see it at the next boot
body:
domain:server#7 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSZ51q2s3nMfakhdJ3

Follow-up from #33238 (PR #33245). This is open question 2 of the dev report on that card; the dev and review#2 (6879548824, 6880449445) both route it to a runtime-lane card of its own. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.

**Gap:** the marketplace install-local door registers a package and then announces `metadata:reloaded` with `app/MANIFESTID`. After PR #33245, plugin-security's `renamedFrom` holder carry runs on that announcement. The runtime's `POST /packages` install and its package enable route also register positions, but neither announces `metadata:reloaded`. On those two doors, a package's renamed positions keep their holders on the old name until the next boot. The same goes for every other `metadata:reloaded` subscriber (for example flows and translations): none of them hears these two doors.

**Expected:** both doors announce `metadata:reloaded` after they register, in the payload spelling install-local uses (`changed: ['app/ID']`), so every subscriber re-syncs as it does for install-local. Pin it: a hot `POST /packages` install of a package that renames a position moves the holder with no restart.

**Measured by the #33238 dev at PR #33245 head; not re-measured here:** neither route calls `trigger('metadata:reloaded', …)`.

Dedupe: `metadata:reloaded packages install enable announce` → #33238 only (the parent card).
